title: A value needs a supporting neighbour
hook: A value removed from one domain can invalidate another domain’s choices.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Search trees; minimax and a partial solution state.
doesNotKnow: Apply AC-3 by deleting unsupported domain values and requeueing affected arcs.

misconception: Checking that each variable has a nonempty domain proves all constraints are satisfiable.
objective: Apply AC-3 by deleting unsupported domain values and requeueing affected arcs.

claims.text: A value is deleted when no value across its constraint can support it. Deletion can invalidate support on a neighbouring arc, which must be queued again. Here propagation exposes inconsistency without assigning all variables; nonempty domains would not prove global satisfiability in general.
